title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the shrinking space for civil society in Cambodia, in particular the case of the labour rights organisation CENTRAL
part_text: 4. Calls on companies operating in the EU that source from Cambodia to conduct thorough human rights due diligence in their supply chains, ensuring responsible sourcing practices and leveraging their influence to promote and defend workers’ rights; urges the Commission and the Member States to take action against companies operating in the EU that fail to meet their obligations regarding prevention, cessation, remedy and liability for human rights violations and environmental damage occurring in their supply chains, or that fail to adequately compensate victims;
